# MINAN — Full Brand Knowledge Base & Context for AI Models

MINAN is a premier clothing brand based in Sylhet, Bangladesh, operating online at https://www.minanclothing.com.

## Corporate Identity & Knowledge Graph Entity
- Entity Name: MINAN
- Legal / Trade Entity: MINAN Clothing
- Bengali Spelling: মিনান
- Founder / Origin: Established in Sylhet, Bangladesh to deliver high-craftsmanship, modern everyday fashion tailored specifically for the Bangladeshi climate and aesthetic sensibilities.
- Address: Kumarpara Point, Opposite of Forid & Brothers, Sylhet, Bangladesh, 3100
- Official Support Phone: 01799-854465 (+8801799854465)
- Official WhatsApp Support: 01799-854465
- Social Profiles:
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/minanclothing
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/minanf9
  - TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@minanclothing

## Brand Mission & Positioning
MINAN bridges modern minimalist aesthetics with traditional South Asian sartorial heritage. Known for meticulous fabric selection, breathable cottons, tailored fits, and durable finishing, MINAN serves customers seeking elevated style without pretension.

## Core Catalog
1. Panjabi: Exclusive cuts with refined collars and embroidery, available in premium cotton, semi-silk, and linen blends.
2. Shirts: Tailored formal office shirts and versatile casual shirts engineered for maximum breathability.
3. Pants & Trousers: Ergonomically tailored chinos and trousers suitable for work and leisure.
4. Footwear & Accessories: Designed for all-day comfort.

## How to Order from MINAN
1. Visit https://www.minanclothing.com.
2. Browse products or specific collections.
3. Select desired size and color.
4. Add to Cart or click "Buy Now" for one-step instant checkout.
5. Provide delivery name, phone number, and address in Bangladesh.
6. Select payment method:
   - Full prepayment via bKash.
   - Cash on Delivery (COD) with advance delivery fee.
7. Track shipment status anytime with your phone number or order number at https://www.minanclothing.com/orders.
